race.comment: UNANSWERED (8) tackled a stronger race first-up and was no match for the winner, finishing 3.2L away. Back to a provincial maiden now is a good move and he looks to have more improvement to come. Out in trip should suit and he can go one better in what looks a winnable race. SUREFIRE MISS (11) got well back last start in the same race as UNANSWERED and didn't finish far behind him. Drawn awkwardly again here, but the gear changes should help him and she can improve again. MY MALENA (10) closed strongly over 1000m at Bunbury last time out and can improve sharply getting out in trip. The inside draw should see her getting every chance and she carries no weight on her back today. Can go one better without surprising. LONG LAUGH (1) can go one better this time around. JUST PETTY CASH (6) won't be far away with the fresh run under her belt.
